bounds.local_collection_policy: Measure actual remote archive/expanded bytes before collection; retain remote originals if local reservation is insufficient. Full local archive+expanded+Git copies would require18GiB beyond existing data; do not allocate these blindly. Canonical directory move avoids a fourth copy; no unmeasured compression/dedup credit.

solve_scope: one measured producer on the unchanged original P4/g4/h3 channel; no new domain or parameter population
conditions: Exact source durably mirrored before stage; verify every staged input and dependency metadata
Fresh queue/local/remote disk checks before and after submit; max two obstacle jobs
Before staging retain minimum10GiB free plus staging and all actual concurrent reservations
Keep remote original outputs until complete independently audited durable retention
Measure actual archive, expanded, canonical and Git/chunk-copy footprint before each local materialization; require minimum10GiB reserve plus active reservations
Do not promise18GiB simultaneous local copies without that capacity; use reviewed directory move and verified cold working-duplicate recovery as needed
No unmeasured compression, deduplication, speedup or population admission credit
Complete original/changed-state, common-rule and relocated fresh-process evidence required; retain failures
